name: FANTASTICS*TRANS―MaguKare―
source:
The main character, Kuro, is a "bluefin tuna mermaid" that swims in the huge Fantra Aquarium.

He was surrounded by many friends and had a happy life watching his favorite keeper every day. But--

…… Suddenly, those happy days disappear as quickly as bubbles.

The world suddenly gets dark and Kuro loses his consciousness. At the same time, Kuro's friends began to suffer one after another and disappeared from the aquarium.

No one could stop the mysterious tragedy, and when Kuro woke up ... he was the only tuna left in the aquarium.

What happened to the huge aquarium?

Kuro begins to work hard to unravel the mystery with the help of his outsider friends.

[Translated from [url=https://tonleiter-p6.com/fantasticstrans/index_magu.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公克罗是一名“蓝鳍金枪鱼人鱼”，在偌大的番特拉水族馆中游弋。

有许多伙伴相伴，每天都能望见最喜欢的饲养员，他过着幸福的生活。然而——

……突然之间，珍贵的日常像泡沫一样，转瞬消散。

眼前骤然陷入黑暗，克罗失去了意识。与此同时，伙伴们也接连痛苦挣扎，从水族馆里消失。

没有人能阻止这场莫名的悲剧。等克罗醒来时……水族馆里只剩下他这一条金枪鱼。

这座巨大的水族馆，究竟发生了什么？

在其他种族的伙伴帮助下，克罗开始为解开谜团而四处奔走。

[译自[url=https://tonleiter-p6.com/fantasticstrans/index_magu.html]官方网站[/url]]
